arguments.value: 67-year-old man with a history of CD5-negative mantle cell lymphoma presented for evaluation and treatment of recurrent fevers with suspected relapsed/progressive disease. He had prior cecal, marrow, and splenic involvement treated with bendamustine-rituximab, then later developed transformed EBV-positive pleomorphic mantle cell lymphoma with extensive nodal disease, which was confirmed clonally related to the original lymphoma. After treatment for EBV and subsequent Tecartus CAR-T therapy, he achieved a complete metabolic response.
